row.title: The criticality snapshot carries the branching ratio
row.body: Each criticality snapshot records branching_ratio (successor items over done items in the window) beside k_eff, and a page burn of a core goal files GOAL-BURN-<id>. Proven by node --test seed/worker/test/criticality.test.js and seed/worker/test/goals.test.js.
